key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders positioned for further RBA rate hikes, with macroeconomic data showing a stalling economy
CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget, while banks forecast biggest house price falls on record
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; Macarthur clears WA bulk test milestone
Bathla construction collapse signals broader fragility in Australia's housing/construction sector; ratings agencies flag Victoria's soaring debt
Small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) show strong momentum in gold and critical minerals
EV sales overtook petrol cars for first time in Australia, driven by soaring fuel costs; energy transition costs mounting
ASIC launches review of whistleblower complaints at Big Four accounting firms, raising governance concerns
Global AI theme persists (Nvidia, Broadcom, C3.ai) but Australia's economy lags Canada on per-capita growth

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces a structural shakeout amid geopolitical noise; small-cap gold and critical-minerals names (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) are outperforming. Macarthur clears WA iron ore bulk test, a positive operational milestone.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure from iron ore price softness. Small-cap gold miners benefit from safe-haven flows amid geopolitical risk. Critical minerals (vanadium, lithium) attract policy tailwinds from energy transition.

sectors.trend: CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications post-budget; banks forecast record house price declines. ASIC whistleblower review at Big Four raises governance overhang. CBA/Westpac fee practices under scrutiny.
sectors.implications: NIM pressure and credit-loss provisions likely to weigh on CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX earnings. Housing downturn threatens mortgage revenue. Regulatory scrutiny adds compliance cost.

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling; energy transition costs mounting; EV adoption accelerates as fuel costs soar. Volkswagen cutting 50,000 jobs signals auto-sector stress.
sectors.implications: Gas producers (WDS.AX, GWO.AX, TMK) benefit from rate upside. EV transition pressures oil majors but supports grid/infrastructure names. Energy transition cost overruns a macro headwind.

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) faces operational trouble; tablet alternatives emerging. CSL remains a defensive anchor. Consumer spending constrained by housing stress and fuel costs.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX retains defensive appeal. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WPG.AX) may see modest benefit from trade-down dynamics. Pharma supply-chain risk warrants monitoring.

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse exposes systemic fragility; housing construction to follow prices lower. Victoria's debt flagged by ratings agencies. Melbourne councils admit infrastructure cannot cope with planned population growth.
sectors.implications: Construction names (WTC.AX, GPT.AX) face demand destruction. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rising rates and falling occupancy. Property developers at elevated risk.

sectors.trend: Global AI momentum intact (Nvidia, Broadcom, C3.ai). Australia faces AI worker and tradie shortages. Domestic tech exposure limited but cloud/infrastructure demand rising.
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure; indirect benefit to data-centre REITs and electrical infrastructure names. Skills shortage constrains productivity growth.

key_themes: RBA rate-hike risk vs. stalling economy – policy dilemma
Housing market correction: record price falls forecast, loan applications collapsing
Construction sector fragility (Bathla) as systemic warning
Iron ore structural shakeout beneath geopolitical noise
EV adoption inflection point in Australia
ASIC regulatory scrutiny of accounting sector
El Nino / cyclone risk to infrastructure and agriculture

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA further rate hikes into a stalling economy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (CSL.AX, WES.AX); underweight property and construction; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and credit deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to banks' mortgage books and property developers; favour banks with diversified revenue (ANZ.AX, NAB.AX)
Avoid leveraged construction and property developers; favour cash-generative infrastructure operators

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price weakness / demand slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify materials exposure toward gold (RCI.AX, NGN.AX) and critical minerals; monitor Chinese steel data
Maintain gold and energy hedges; monitor AUD/USD for safe-haven flows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Nino / cyclone damage to infrastructure and agriculture
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review insurance coverage on physical assets; monitor S&P/ASX 200 insurance and ag names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical-minerals small caps
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical risk premium, rate-hike uncertainty, and energy-transition demand support gold (Aurum, RCI.AX) and vanadium/lithium (Vanadium Resources, Power Minerals) names

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Stalling economy and rate risk favour low-beta, dividend-paying names; CSL and Wesfarmers offer resilience

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gas/energy exposure on rate surge
opportunities.rationale: TMK Energy gas rates rising; Mongolian drilling and energy-transition cost overflows support gas demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge property and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price falls forecast, 15% loan application drop, Bathla collapse signal sector-wide stress; Victoria debt warning adds fiscal risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim large-cap iron ore exposure pending shakeout clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural iron ore demand softness masked by geopolitics; Macarthur milestone is positive but sector-wide pricing pressure persists

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain AUD/USD short hedge or gold allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Stalling Australian economy vs. Canada, rate-hike risk, and geopolitical uncertainty pressure AUD

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months as RBA rate-hike expectations, housing correction fears, and construction-sector fragility dominate. Small-cap gold and critical minerals may outperform. Expect volatility around RBA communications and Chinese iron ore data.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots to cuts once inflation cools. Housing market bottoming would unlock rate cuts and support banks/REITs. AI and energy-transition themes provide structural growth. Key risk: prolonged stagnation if construction contagion spreads.
